title: Oppo Launches the Reno17 Pro with a 200-Megapixel Camera! 📸
body: Oppo Launches the Reno17 Pro with a 200-Megapixel Camera! 📸

Oppo has launched the Reno17 Pro in China: a 6.32-inch AMOLED display, a 200-megapixel main camera, a 7,250 mAh battery with 80W fast charging, and a Dimensity 8550 Super processor — starting at $509.
A 200-megapixel camera... does it really make a difference in your photos? 🤔
